speak.title: Role-play: a Friday night out
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the friend who wants to go
a.text: You went to a ceilidh last week and loved it. Invite your friend for Friday. Explain what it is like, answer their worries and try to agree a plan.

b.role: the friend who is not sure
b.text: You are tired and think dancing in front of strangers sounds embarrassing. Ask questions, say what worries you, and decide if you can agree a plan you both like.

phrases: Why don't you come to a ceilidh with me?
I'm not very good at dancing.
Don't worry, you don't need a partner.
That's not really my kind of evening.
How about we try it for an hour? If you're not enjoying it, we'll leave.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: are you going to the ceilidh, and what changed your mind?
